title: feat(spec, lint): user-facing refusal and advisory text is in the request locale; authoring findings carry a localized user sentence, security posture first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR6myLrdmzXTYxoSyjXrroZ)_
Fixes #32655

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #32844

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：协议里写明，给最终用户看的文字（`userMessage`）按请求的语言给出。平台自己出的文案依次取请求语言、工作区默认语言、英文，`fr-FR`、`en-GB` 这类带地区的写法按其语言读；应用自己写的拒绝文案走应用的翻译，没有就用原文。保存和发布返回的提示条目可以带一句 `userMessage`；7 条安全类保存提示在 11 种平台语言里都有了用户文案。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」。中文用户保存后看到的是英文安全提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案，规则 id 不变。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个可选字段和一批文案，现有返回内容一字不变（服务端还没填这个字段，那是第 2 层的卡）；`@objectstack/spec` 因新增字段按 minor 发版；回滚就是撤回本 PR。本 PR 取代 #32721（同一份改动，换到本线程分支续做）。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts`（“Language”一节）、`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.ts`（语言回退规则）、`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`（各语言文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.test.ts`，应看到 28 个测试全过，其中有 `fr-FR` 请求在中文工作区里拿到法语句子的用例。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

This replaces #32721. It is the same development: that PR's head `9925cc13` was taken over by this card thread on its own branch, which the platform assigns (the original branch is not pushable from here). On top of it come merges of current `main`, the changeset round the seat ruled (`@objectstack/spec` goes `patch` → `minor`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` becomes `added`), and the fixes from contract review round 1 (record 6835490406, FAIL), which the delta review passed (record 6836106570).

Layer 1 of #32654 (the contract), under ruling record 6819749037 on #32440: option C of analysis 6819513436, 「服务端按请求语言返回本地化的 advisory 文案，规则 id 不变;控制台、CLI、MCP 都直接得到译文。」

**`packages/spec`.** These are descriptions and one new optional key.

- `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/contract.zod.ts`) gains a "Language" section, and `EnhancedApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/errors.zod.ts`) points to it. The text is in the request's locale, composed by its producer, and consumers render it as received.
  - Platform-composed text follows one ladder: the locale the request names (`Accept-Language`, or `?locale` on REST), else the workspace default (the `localization` settings), else `en`.
  - Each rung's code is read through `platformLocaleTagOf` whole and then one subtag shorter at a time, so `fr-FR` reads as `fr`, `en-GB` as `en` and `zh-Hant-US` as `zh-Hant`. The first table language a prefix names decides, so a Traditional Chinese code is never handed Simplified text. A rung that names no table language, or whose language the producer has no text for, is passed over.
  - A producer needs the request locale and the workspace default as two values. `ExecutionContext.locale` is their fold, so it alone cannot serve the second rung.
  - App-authored text, such as a hook's catalogued refusal, is not on this ladder: it is served through the app's translations in the caller's locale, else as declared.
  - The ruled meaning ("Producer-marked user-facing refusal text, verbatim") does not change; only the language is new.
- `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` (`src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) is the one finding shape behind the save and publish doors' `advisories[]` and the 422's `issues[]`. It gains an optional `userMessage`, with the same name, the same producer-marked meaning and the platform-composed ladder. `rule` is still the stable id, and `message` / `hint` are still the developer-facing English. A response without the key parses exactly as before. A client that parses a response with the key now keeps it instead of stripping it.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` (13 pages carry the error envelope) and `authorable-surface/api.json`, which now lists `api/RuntimeAuthoringIssue:userMessage`. `authorable-surface.base.json` is unchanged.

**`packages/lint`: the producer side.** The catalog lives with the producer. That placement is this lane's call within the ruling.

- `AuthoringFinding.userTextParams?` holds the names a finding's user sentence interpolates. A rule cannot see the request, so it emits names, not text.
- `finding-user-text.ts` holds the types, the locale ladder (`userTextLocaleOf`, reading each candidate as the contract states), the catalog merge (which refuses a rule id that two catalogs both claim) and the merged catalog. `findingUserMessage(finding, [requestLocale, workspaceDefault])` returns the `userMessage` value, or `undefined` when the producer authors no sentence for that finding. It and the `UserTextParams` type are the only exports, on the root entry and on `@objectstack/lint/runtime`, the entry `metadata-protocol` is pinned to.
- `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` sits beside the rule. It holds the sentences of the seven advisory rule ids in all 11 platform locales, using the console's own terms. The seven rules are `security-private-no-readscope`, `security-master-detail-ungranted`, `security-book-audience-unknown-set`, `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`, `security-controlled-by-parent-master-reference-hidden`, `security-update-policy-no-check` and `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in`. Their eight push sites in `validate-security-posture.ts` now set `userTextParams`. Rule ids, messages and hints are unchanged.
- The field-mask advisory's params also carry `inert` (`read`, `edit` or `both`), the half of the field restriction the set's bypass unbinds, and its sentence has one arm per value. Beside View All Records only hiding the field is ineffective and the read-only setting still holds, so that arm never calls the whole restriction ineffective and never prescribes deleting it.

**Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` `minor` and `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, with `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added`. The new key moves the `api` authorable-surface shard, and AGENTS.md treats a new key as `added`. This is the seat's call A on the declaration question an earlier round raised.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (layer 2, #32656) and the console rendering it (layer 3, #32657). `metadata-protocol`'s `toIssue` still copies the six keys, so every save and publish response stays byte-identical until #32656 lands.

## Why

The console renders a server advisory such as `security-private-no-readscope` in English inside a zh-CN Studio. The ruling puts the translation where the rule's wording lives. The console, the CLI and MCP then all receive localized text, and no consumer has to keep its own per-rule translation table.

## Contract review

- Round 1 on `495a9ee9`, record 6835490406 (brief 6835468914): FAIL, with one must-fix, three should-fix and three nits.
  - M1: the ladder read a region code (`fr-FR`, `en-GB`, `es-MX`) with a bare table lookup and so skipped its own language.
  - S1: the contract gave app-authored refusals an `en` floor they do not have.
  - S2: it cited `ExecutionContext.locale` as the two rungs.
  - S3: the View All arm of the field-mask sentence called the whole restriction ineffective.
  - N1: five internals sat on the lint root entry. N2: the update-policy sentence leaves out the remedy's side effect. N3: API names and stand-ins appear in the sentences.
- Fix commit `72c76c98` covers M1, S1, S2, S3 and N1, and records N3 in the catalog header. N2 stands as an accepted deviation for the native-read card.
- Delta round on `67967800`, record 6836106570 (brief 6836096631): **PASS**. It rates M1, S1, S2, S3 and N1 fixed and N3 an accepted deviation. Two nits stand: N2, and a new N4 for layer 2.
  - N4: the contract's aside on the operation refusals says a language their catalog lacks reads `en`, but `resolveBundleLocale` hands a `zh-TW` request their `zh-CN` text. Bringing those refusals onto the ladder in #32656 takes both locale values and the table reading.

## Tests

All counts are from the tree at `b30e1b29`. That is the round-1 fix `72c76c98` with `main` `c249611b` merged in through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (12 incoming commits, no conflicts, no generated artifact changed by the merge). The head `67967800` adds only a rewrap of one pt-BR source line, whose rendered string is unchanged (see Verification).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 200 passed (200), Tests 8571 passed (8571). The lock reported `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 836 passed (836), Tests 26737 passed, 1 todo. `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.test.ts` (28 tests):
  - the locale ladder: alias reads (`zh-CN` resolves to `zh-Hans`); region and script codes read one subtag shorter at a time ahead of the workspace default (`fr-FR`, `en-GB`, `es-MX`, `pt-PT` to `pt-BR`, `zh-Hant-US` to `zh-Hant`); the workspace default read the same way; a Traditional code whose language the entry lacks passes to the next rung and never reaches Simplified; the workspace default when the request locale is unset, names no table language (`vi-VN`) or has no sentence (`ja`); and `en` as the floor (`tlh`);
  - the duplicate-catalog refusal, and no sentence for a finding without params;
  - the catalog holds exactly the 7 ids, each in exactly the 11 platform locales;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings in every locale, with the names interpolated, no `undefined`, and no English stand-in;
  - the remedy and bypass variants, and the field-mask sentence's three `inert` arms: each calls only its own half ineffective, and the three render apart in every locale;
  - real findings rendered for `fr-FR`, `en-GB`, `de-AT`, `ko-KR` and `zh-Hant-HK` requests in a `zh-CN` workspace answer in the request's language;
  - a `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` permission write whose advisory renders a `userMessage` that `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` accepts beside the unchanged rule id.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the finding parses with and without `userMessage`; a non-string value is refused; the save response keeps a localized `userMessage` on an advisory.

<details><summary>Ablation and reverse type check (development round, at b22507da)</summary>

Ablation: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the `userTextParams` line at the `security-private-no-readscope` push site. The anchor count went from 1 to 0. Result: Tests 3 failed, 20 passed (23), and the three failures are exactly the cases that read that finding. After restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the rule from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

Reverse type check: a temporary probe in `packages/lint/src`, compiled against the rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` `.d.ts`, gave exactly one error, `TS2322` on `userMessage: 42`. The string forms compiled, including an excess-property object literal. The probe was deleted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

1. **Replaces #32721.** That PR's branch `claude/issue-32655-localized-user-text-contract` (head `9925cc13`) is not pushable from this card thread's container, so the work continues on the branch the platform assigns, `claude/project-thread-tpz7ec`, started from that sha with `main` merged in (no rebase, no force-push). The Duplicate Fix Guard sees a branch that does not name the issue. #32721 is no longer open, and the seat's pointer comment 6832201213 on it leads here.
2. **Declaration resolved.** An earlier round's `Metadata-protocol: none` was refused by `Check Changeset` because the `api` shard moved. The seat ruled A: `added`, with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`. `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head.
3. **`Skills-docs:` follow-up owed.** The two skills files named above should teach the new field. Product PRs never edit `skills/**`, filed as #32844.
4. **Remaining advisory rules.** A static scan at `9925cc13` found 74 lint rule ids that the save door can return as advisories; this PR covers 7 of them. The other **67, in 36 rule files**, are carded: tracking #32835 with sub-cards #32836, #32837, #32838, #32840 and #32842. Until they land, those advisories render the declared English fallback. `metadata-protocol`'s own gate-local advisories belong to layer 2.
5. **The non-English sentences are agent-written.** No native speaker has read them: the seven entries in ten languages, with the field-mask entry now in three arms and the owner-policy entry in three remedy variants. Review card #32843 (ar, ja, ko and zh-Hant first), and layer 3 (#32657) should wait on it before rendering them to users. Review nit N2 rides on that card.
6. **CLI JSON grows one key.** `os validate --json` / `os build --json` serialize findings as they are, so the seven security advisories now also show `userTextParams` in `warnings`, and the field-mask one carries `inert` inside it. The change is additive, and no CLI test pins that element's exact shape.
7. **For layer 2 (#32656).** In `toIssue` (`metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`), add `userMessage: findingUserMessage(f, [requestLocale, workspaceDefaultLocale])` when it is defined, imported from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`. Pass both locales, as the contract now says: `ExecutionContext.locale` folds them into one value, which drops the workspace default whenever the request names a locale. Review nit N4 is for the same card: the operation refusals (`renderOperationMessage`) take one locale and match it through `resolveBundleLocale`, so bringing them onto the ladder takes both values and the table reading.
8. **A standing-rule conflict, flagged.** This body's last line is the relay's HTML-comment `signed:` trailer, as the dispatch asked, while `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` forbids HTML comments in dev-written GitHub text. Seat disposition: a conflict inside the pm kit is a principle gap, so it goes to the seat's clock-out brief for the maintainer, not to a card (seat-lifecycle).
9. **Field-mask hint, outside this diff.** The rule's developer `hint` for that advisory still ends "or delete the entry if the bypass is meant" for the View All case as well, where deleting the entry would also drop its edit lock, which still binds beside View All (the rule's own comment says so). The user sentence no longer says so. The hint is unchanged here, because hints are out of this card's scope.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `b30e1b29` derived 113 commands, the same list as on earlier heads. Each line is recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`; the run started on `b30e1b29` and its later commands read the tree at `67967800`, which differs only by the rewrap.
  - All 113 exited 0 on the first pass (the teardown self-test's pinned fixture commit was fetched in an earlier round).
  - `--ran` reconciliation: "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 113 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event EVENT.json`, with this body as the payload: exit 0, "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes` and metadata-protocol `added`, and it grades a package whose published source … it moves at `minor` or above — the declared widening is accounted for". `@objectstack/lint` is graded `patch` and not refused.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after the merge, with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` (the default heap runs out in `check:test-typecheck`): "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". The tree was clean after the run, so the merge needed no regeneration commit.
- `node scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs` at `67967800`: green, 1300 literals across 423 files. On `b30e1b29` CI's "CLI command-id literals resolve" step was red: a pt-BR template segment opened with "os campos", which the gate reads as an `os` command. `67967800` moves the article to the line above. That gate is a CI lint step and is not among the 113 derived commands.
- `npx eslint` on the eight changed TypeScript source files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and `Clause-②:` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.
- CI on `67967800`: 68 check-runs, 58 success and 10 skipped, none failed. That includes `PR-body guards`, which went green on this head once #32721 was no longer open, `Lint · docs & code guards`, the four Type Check lanes, Test Core (8/8 shards) and Test UI (16/16 shards).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
